content:
Nadia (CS): quick thread on Trellis renewal 150 seats. buyer wants to switch from PO to eSign+card. procurement insists on vendor code and full SOW. missing: signed PO or eSign SOW, vendor id, billing email. looping @Ethan and @Priya
Ethan (Sales): buyer sent vendor id 'TRS-GB-7' but finance says legal name mismatch vs registry. they can eSign today if we accept CC fallback for month1.
Priya (Legal): we can allow eSign + CC for first invoice only if buyer signs a 1-paragraph commitment: deliver signed PO or registered vendor confirmation within 10 days. i'll draft addendum.
Sam (Ops): ops needs exact legal entity (no abbreviations), SOW pdf, and billing contact. we can provision seats on tokenized card but flag account as "pending docs"; no production keys until SOW attached.
Nadia (CS): pasted buyer DM snippet:
```
PO#: (pending)
Bill To: Trellis Technologies Ltd
Seats: 150
Term: 12mo
Total: GBP 45,000
Billing: finance@trellis.tech
Vendor ID: TRS-GB-7 (provisional)
```
billing-bot: draft INV-4551 created GBP 45,000  status: draft, missing SOW. link: https://billing.internal/INV-4551
Ethan (Sales): recommended flow: 1) send addendum for eSign 2) capture card for month1 after addendum signed 3) require PO or vendor confirmation within 10 days or apply late PO fee.
Priya (Legal): fine. addendum will say: "Buyer agrees to deliver signed PO or registered vendor confirmation within 10 calendar days; otherwise Seller may suspend services or bill additional fees." drafting now.
Sam (Ops): ops checklist: [ ] SOW pdf [ ] Signed PO or vendor confirmation [ ] Billing email verified [ ] Card tokenized for month1. will hold production keys until SOW received.
Nadia (CS): i'll ask buyer to eSign addendum and upload company registration + VAT cert. ETA they gave: "by Friday" but sounded uncertain. will update here. :thumbsup:
